logic.depth: originating breakout close minus crossed prior boundary, signed and divided by originating ATR; >=threshold
logic.confirm: next completed bar close remains beyond frozen boundary, else cancel
logic.retest: within next4 completed bars low<=upper boundary (buy) or high>=lower (sell), close beyond; cancel on close inside
logic.failed_reverse: within next2 completed bars close inside frozen [low,high], reverse originating direction; origin parent guards only; expiry cancels
logic.exit: fixed parent SL2.5ATR/TP; failed1 close across original crossed boundary; stagnant8 bars net<=0; trail after net>=.5 initial cost-inclusiveR at close, low-tick/high+tick with cost-covering break-even, never widen; effective later quote
logic.drawdown_admission: flat equity vs all-tick peak: DD>=15% cap2.5%; else DD>=10% cap5%; else configured cap; never increase configured cap or change0.01lot
logic.protection_activation: completed-bar executable net>=protect_after_r times initial cost-inclusive risk; default0.5, newresearch1/1.5/2; SL never widens, later quote effect
logic.trend_pullback: EMA50 fixed with4bar slope. BUY prior candle red,current close>prior high and>EMA,risingEMA;SELL inverse; first50barswarmup; triggerSL, completedbarquoteentry
logic.wick_sweep: prior48 range upper wick: high>hh, close<hh, low>=ll=>sell; lower wick: low<ll, close>ll, high<=hh=>buy. Ambiguous both-edge candle skipped; completedbar only, firstfreshquote, stop behindwick
logic.boundary_stop: crossed originating level minus signed0.5ATR buffer; fixed rule, not an ATR grid. Entries only during declared UTC sessions; net negative exits start cooldown and count toward UTC daily loss circuit; protection remains active outside sessions
logic.risk_target: when target_rr>0, TP distance=initial rounded stop distance times nominal RR; otherwise parent ATR target. Trigger stop uses confirming bar low/high only; all fees and exit allowances still counted in admission
logic.structure_stop: research contract only: setup/trigger minimum low-tick for buy, maximum high+tick for sell; reject wrong-side or over-cap SL; preserves parent target ATR
logic.daily: block new entries after realized balance drop relative UTC day-start equity; missing midnight equity blocks admission

missing_evidence: MQL5 real-tick parity and delay testing
shadow >=20trading days and >=30eligible decisions, zero unexplained mismatch
